Metric notes: Dataset is synthetic. It has approved_amount, not actual paid_amount; this dashboard uses approved claims as a proxy. Annual premium is not earned premium, so claim ratio is indicative and may exceed 100%. Month applies to each dataset's own date: policy start month for premium, claim date month for claims, renewal due month for renewals. Age and treatment filters affect claim visuals/KPIs, not premium or renewal totals because member-level premium allocation is unavailable. *Policies in force is approximated from policies started by the latest policy date; expiry/cancellation dates are not supplied.
